searchText: Thank you Marius. It is so much helpful. When is the goerli merge EF blog announcement scheduled to go up? Hello Again EF team. I'm wonder that validator index or pubkey can be matched with fee recipient address. Anyone knows about this? They can be matched once you created a block post-merge, since the fee recipient is part of the ExecutionPayload. Btw this discord is all ethereum researchers and devlopers, not only EF Oh that's my mistake. Thank you for pointing out. I mean can I get the information about pair of validator info with its fee recipient address through beacon chain api? Or any other api?? I couldnt' find about this. No not yet, it's a n:n relationship. I don't think you'll see RPC apis popping up for this. My guess is that indexing services (etherscan, beachchain) will probably create something for this Got it thanks. Also, there are no specific fee addresses for validators. The fee recipient address is provided upon the proposal of the block. In fact, a single validator may use any address as a fee recipient, no matter anything. Beacon chain is not specifying nor enforcing the fee recipient address. Friday? I assume. <@552133098075193354> would know more. Clients are putting their polish on Waiting on the last couple client releases to press "publish". I think either this PM PT or early PT tomorrow! A lot of client releases are already out btw: if you use Erigon Geth Nethermind Lighthouse Lodestar Nimbus Teku, you can find the release on their repo already 🙂

excerpts.content:
Hello Again EF team. 
I'm wonder that validator index or pubkey can be matched with fee recipient address. 
Anyone knows about this?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
They can be matched once you created a block post-merge, since the fee recipient is part of the ExecutionPayload.
Btw this discord is all ethereum researchers and devlopers, not only EF

excerpts.author: johnydony
excerpts.content:
Oh that's my mistake. 
Thank you for pointing out. 
I mean  can I get the information about pair of validator info with its fee recipient address through beacon chain api?

Or any other api??

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
No not yet, it's a n:n relationship. I don't think you'll see RPC apis popping up for this.
My guess is that indexing services (etherscan, beachchain) will probably create something for this

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
excerpts.content: Also, there are no specific fee addresses for validators. The fee recipient address is provided upon the proposal of the block. In fact, a single validator may use any address as a fee recipient, no matter anything.

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
excerpts.content: Beacon chain is not specifying nor enforcing the fee recipient address.
